- Next turn you are told which 4 symbols those keys held, as a list sorted in the same fixed order as the symbol list above. You are NOT told which symbol came from which key. Overlap your chords cleverly to pin symbols to keys.

You may end the game at any time by submitting your full guess. After turn 30 you MUST submit it. Your main score is how many of the 39 keys you guess correctly, judged against the arrangement at the moment you guess.
